text: Yes, all days of the period were checked for thermal detections on this property. The current evidence (version 2) indicates that every day from October 1, 2026, to October 8, 2026, was covered by all sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS). No thermal detections were found intersecting the asset during this period. The initial evidence (version 1) had temporal gaps due to data not being published yet, but these were filled in the updated version.
